mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.prj_id,a.dev_id,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_se_cd,a.cntrct_dev_id, a.rplc_asgn_id,a.ext_psblty_cd,a.asgn_stts_cd,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.use_yn,p.prj_stts_cd,d.emp_se_cd,d.rsgn_dt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.asgn_no,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,a.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.mng_no,a.job_cd,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt, a.plan_end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_se_cd, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE a.untprc_base_cd END AS untprc_base_cd, a.ext_psblty_cd,a.cntrct_dev_id,cp.dev_nm AS cntrct_dev_nm,a.asgn_stts_cd,a.rplc_asgn_id, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','IN') THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT r.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r WHERE r.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND r.aply_bgn_dt<=#{today} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) END AS bill_untprc_amt, COALESCE((SELECT m.mm_qty FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month}),0) AS current_month_mm_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=#{month}),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND LEFT(m.work_ym,4)=#{year}),0) AS year_mm_qty, COALESCE(a.updated_at,a.created_at) AS updated_at FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev cp ON cp.dev_id=a.cntrct_dev_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}
SELECT a.rmrk_desc FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT h.asgn_chg_id,h.asgn_id,h.asgn_chg_ty_cd,h.aply_dt,h.bfr_val,h.aft_val,h.new_asgn_id, h.rsn_cd,c.cd_nm AS rsn_nm,h.rsn_desc,h.retro_yn,h.fixed_yn,h.fix_trgt_chg_id, t.aply_dt AS fix_trgt_aply_dt,t.asgn_chg_ty_cd AS fix_trgt_chg_ty_cd,h.chg_user_id, u.user_nm AS chg_user_nm,h.chg_at FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl c ON c.cd_grp_id='ASGN_CHG_RSN' AND c.dtl_cd=h.rsn_cd LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_chg_hist t ON t.asgn_chg_id=h.fix_trgt_chg_id AND t.asgn_id=h.asgn_id LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.chg_user_id WHERE h.asgn_id=#{id}
mapper.select: AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd=#{type} ORDER BY h.aply_dt DESC,h.chg_at DESC,h.asgn_chg_id DESC
SELECT r.aply_bgn_dt,r.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist r WHERE r.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_dt

SELECT m.work_ym,m.auto_mm_qty,m.mm_qty,m.mnl_yn, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth n JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.asgn_id=n.asgn_id WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND n.work_ym=m.work_ym),0) AS person_month_mm_qty, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=m.work_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS closed_yn FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE m.asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.work_ym
SELECT c.cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY c.cls_ym
SELECT c.cd_nm FROM cmn.cd_dtl c JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=c.cd_grp_id WHERE c.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND c.dtl_cd=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y'
SELECT d.dev_id FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} AND d.use_yn='Y'
SELECT MIN(x.bgn_dt) FROM asgn.asgn x JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=#{id} WHERE x.prj_id=a.prj_id AND x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'
SELECT o.num_val::integer FROM cmn.oprt_std o WHERE o.oprt_std_id='DISPATCH_MAX_MONTHS' AND o.aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY o.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'OVER_MM' AS code,'MM 1.0 초과' AS message,m.work_ym FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn x ON x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=x.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} GROUP BY m.work_ym HAVING SUM(m.mm_qty)>1.00 UNION ALL SELECT 'PRE_CONTRACT','미계약 선투입',NULL FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN' UNION ALL SELECT 'ON_LEAVE','휴직 기간 배정',NULL FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=a.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt<=a.end_dt AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt>=a.bgn_dt)) UNION ALL SELECT 'DISPATCH_NONREG','파견에 프리랜서·외주 배정',NULL FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND d.emp_se_cd IN ('FL','OS') UNION ALL SELECT 'OTHER_PROJECT_OVERLAP','다른 프로젝트와 투입 기간이 겹칩니다.',NULL FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn x WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.prj_id!=a.prj_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND x.bgn_dt<=a.end_dt AND x.end_dt>=a.bgn_dt)
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.asgn SET ext_psblty_cd=#{value} WHERE asgn_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asgn.untprc_hist(asgn_id,aply_bgn_dt,bill_untprc_amt,rsn_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{id},#{effective},#{amount},#{reason},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(asgn_id,aply_bgn_dt) DO UPDATE SET bill_untprc_amt=EXCLUDED.bill_untprc_amt,rsn_desc=EXCLUDED.rsn_desc
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.untprc_hist SET aply_bgn_dt=#{after} WHERE asgn_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_dt=#{before}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asgn.asgn_mth(asgn_id,work_ym,auto_mm_qty,mm_qty,mnl_yn) SELECT #{id},#{month},#{automatic},#{quantity},#{manual} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month} AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED') ON CONFLICT(asgn_id,work_ym) DO UPDATE SET auto_mm_qty=EXCLUDED.auto_mm_qty, mm_qty=CASE WHEN asgn.asgn_mth.mnl_yn='Y' THEN asgn.asgn_mth.mm_qty ELSE EXCLUDED.mm_qty END
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.asgn_chg_hist SET fixed_yn='Y' WHERE asgn_id=#{id} AND asgn_chg_id=#{chgId} AND fixed_yn='N' AND asgn_chg_ty_cd NOT IN ('START','FIX')
